fact: UNESCO's contribution to the 42nd Universal Periodic Review states that Gabon has no access to information law and encourages it to adopt one; no draft is named. The document gives no event date, so its published date is used.

Journalist Herton-Sena Omoungou writes in a Convergence Afrique op-ed that no law sets out access to administrative documents in Gabon, and a bill announced in 2023 remains a rough draft not yet submitted to Parliament.
